overall: The AG found the Assessors violated the Open Meeting Law by refusing to let the complainant record its November 16, 2011 open meeting; no advance written notice was required, only verbal notice to the chair at the meeting.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleges the Assessors refused to let him video record its November 16, 2011 open meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Such conduct does not appear to interfere with the conduct of the meeting, and recording should therefore have been permitted, following verbal notice to the chair.

remedy: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting law, and note that future similar violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Law.
